Part of #69 (slices 2-4, combined into one PR per ungood's direction — small individually, easier

- One `directus` Cloud SQL database (not split per use case — Directus's own collections are how

- Secret Manager secrets: `directus-key`, `directus-secret`, `directus-db-password`,
  `directus-admin-bootstrap-password`, and a native-OIDC Google OAuth client
  (`directus-oauth-client-id`/`-secret`, separate from the portal's).
- Generalize `portal-bootstrap.ts` (currently single-app) into a multi-service compose stack:
  portal + Directus, sharing the one Caddy container, routed by hostname (`cycsail.team` vs
  `crm.cycsail.team`). Directus from the official image, native Google OIDC login (no oauth2-proxy
  needed for this surface).
- New DNS `A` record `crm.<internalDomain>`.
- A committed Directus schema snapshot implementing the collections/fields/relations from
  `docs/people-hub-schema.md`, applied on boot/deploy, plus the Administrator/Staff/Coach/Guardian
  roles and access policies.
- `docs/manual-setup.md` additions for the one-time steps (Directus OIDC client, provisioning first
  staff users) — mirrors Section 5 (portal Google auth).

## Verification

`just ci` + `pulumi preview` for the IaC; schema/permissions verified against a local Directus
container where practical; live boot/deploy and schema apply verified manually against the VM
(human-gated, same as the portal).
EOF
)" 2>&1
